answer:9a57ac42-b7b4-445b-ab6d-517ba64e2: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
answer:ebf6394b-59a3-48c1-85f7-afcd97dd9: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:d76c40ea-c20c-4f69-9538-52f8b4e5b: Yes. The root user of our production AWS account (111122223333) has multi-factor authentication.
answer:1100feca-94cf-406f-a19c-6e0b6517d: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:ef1f4b9e-ba1b-4c43-b0ec-d2ac2f0f1: IAM users in our AWS account (111122223333) must use passwords of at least 14 characters, and passwords expire after 90 days.
